An armored champion of the North-kingdom, whose thundering charge has broken countless enemy formations. The Knight of Arthedain combines Arthedain discipline with Fornost's proud cavalry tradition, becoming an immovable wall of steel.
An elite scout who strikes from the wilds of Eriador, ambushing the servants of Angmar with deadly precision.

A battle-hardened infantry officer who holds the walls of Fornost against the hosts of Angmar, forging order from chaos when the North Downs burn. The Warden holds the line where others would break, rallying soldiers through sheer force of will.
